# Frostline OPS

> Frostline OPS is back-office software for snow removal businesses.

## What it does

- Manages commercial and residential client records.
- Organizes seasonal contracts with itemized services.
- Tracks deposits, installments, balances, payment methods, and payment dates.
- Produces printable invoices and payment receipts as PDFs.
- Exports a season of payment records as CSV for accounting.
- Provides revenue and client-growth dashboards.

## Who it is for

Snow removal contractors and their office teams who need one reliable place for clients, contracts, payments, and receipts. Frostline OPS does not dispatch trucks or manage field crews.

## Plans

Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and no credit card. The Free plan supports one user and up to 15 clients. Pro supports unlimited users and clients and is billed annually at CA$300, tax-exclusive.
